reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited text supports the preferred position: §13.1 extends the hosted-Services right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors; §13.2 grants a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free paid-up licence including modification and contractor support; §13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and limits revocation/suspension to material uncured breach after notice and cure.
No at-will revocation language remains and affiliates/contractors are named, consistent with both deterministic checks; the licence clearly benefits our party so flagging would be over-reaching.
Reference to §13.4 use restrictions is outside the supplied paragraphs but is non-material color in the rationale and does not affect the compliant classification.
